watch.name: sleep-materially-worse
watch.nl_query: Tell me if my sleep has been getting materially worse over the past two weeks.

nodes.comment: Duration is summed from asleep stages and quality proxied by deep+REM minutes — the table has neither column. Persistence plus rising edge keep the judge asleep until the picture genuinely changes.
nodes.query: WITH nightly AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', start_time) AS night, sum(CASE WHEN stage IN ('asleepCore','asleepDeep','asleepREM','asleepUnspecified') THEN date_diff('minute', start_time, end_time) END) AS asleep_min, sum(CASE WHEN stage IN ('asleepDeep','asleepREM') THEN date_diff('minute', start_time, end_time) END) AS deep_rem_min FROM health_sleep GROUP BY 1), recent AS (SELECT avg(asleep_min) AS d, avg(deep_rem_min) AS q FROM nightly WHERE night > $today - INTERVAL 14 DAY), base AS (SELECT avg(asleep_min) AS d, avg(deep_rem_min) AS q FROM nightly WHERE night BETWEEN $today - INTERVAL 74 DAY AND $today - INTERVAL 14 DAY) SELECT (recent.d < base.d * 0.9 OR recent.q < base.q * 0.85) AS fires, recent.d AS recent_duration, base.d AS baseline_duration, recent.q AS recent_deep_rem, base.q AS baseline_deep_rem FROM recent, base

nodes.comment: Numbers in, typed decision out — no document access.
nodes.proposition: Given these sleep statistics, the deterioration is material rather than noise or a one-off; sustained causes (travel, illness) still count
